episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Landlord Gi Su-jong struggles to make ends meet and faces the threat of losing his property.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Desperate to save his building, Su-jong stages an abduction in an attempt to pay off his debt.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Su-jong pulls off the staged abduction, unaware that Detective Ko Ju-ran is on his tail.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As secrets continue to unravel, Su-jong faces a new threat.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Su-jong receives an offer on his building and attempts to eliminate other threats.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Su-jong and his wife, Kim Seon, face a dangerous situation and go against all odds to survive.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: While Su-jong's daughter, Da-rae, uncovers her parents' secrets, Su-jong discovers another body.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Su-jong and Kim Seon's plans backfire.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Su-jong tries to keep his family safe, but things go awry

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: A brutal fight breaks out as Su-jong's building catches fire.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Su-jong escapes the police while Kim Seon struggles to hold on to crucial evidence against Real Capital.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: As Su-jong makes an unexpected alliance, he finds himself facing the music for his past actions.
